summary: Frontend-only regression sweep of the batch overhaul (name swap Jelly Jukebox / Who's Got the Rhythm, ALL-CAPS NES-style submenu tiles, Lou blimp on Play/Learn/Create, Lessons cascade layout with real names, JMAtv 4-channel expansion + STREAMING NOW rename, JMAtv 'channel' scrub, back-button rules). Tested via Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All routes rendered without console errors and no page errors were captured. Two real bugs found — see below.

ui_bugs.issue: Mode label rename NOT applied. Line 47 still reads `label: 'Echo Stew'`. On /boom-garden the third-from-left card renders 'ECHO STEW' (see screenshot) instead of 'PARROT PERCUSSION'. Consequently the in-game GameHeader reads 'Who's Got the Rhythm · Echo Stew' instead of the expected 'Who's Got the Rhythm · Parrot Percussion'. Tagline 'Stew plays. You play it back.' also not visible. Note: the data-testid is still `boom-mode-copy` so nav wiring is fine — only the display label needs updating.

The word 'channel' still appears in visible copy on the VARIETY SHOW empty state. Line 167 empty-state body reads: 'Fresh episodes are on the way. Check the other channels in the meantime.' — this violates the 'no word channel anywhere in JMAtv copy' rule for /jmatv/variety-show. Suggested rewrite: 'Fresh episodes are on the way. Check out the other shows in the meantime.'

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/BoomGardenPage.js line ~47, change `label: 'Echo Stew'` to `label: 'Parrot Percussion'` (and, if the design calls for it, add a `tagline: 'Stew plays. You play it back.'` field the ModeTile can render). This will also fix the in-game GameHeader which composes 'Who's Got the Rhythm · {mode.label}'.

In /app/frontend/src/pages/JMAtvChannelPage.js line ~167, remove the word 'channels' from the empty-state copy (e.g. change 'Check the other channels in the meantime.' → 'Check the other shows in the meantime.') so that /jmatv/variety-show honours the no-'channel' rule.
critical_code_review_comments: BoomGardenPage.js is ~1100 lines — should be split (mode config, useDrumAudio hook, three mode-runtime functions, GameHeader wrapper).
JMAtvChannelPage empty-state copy is hard-coded; consider sourcing 'coming soon' body text from data/jmatv.js so future channel-name/word-scrub rules can be enforced in one place.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (13 of 14 visible checks pass; 2 real bugs found)

seed_data_creation: None. Set localStorage.jma_player_name_prompted_v1='1' and sessionStorage.jma_audio_unlocked_v1='1' to bypass first-run modals, plus clicked the audio-unlock overlay when it still appeared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two known bugs to re-verify after fix: (1) /boom-garden should show 'PARROT PERCUSSION' (not 'ECHO STEW') on the third mode card, and entering that mode should render header 'Who's Got the Rhythm · Parrot Percussion'; (2) /jmatv/variety-show empty state must not contain the word 'channel' (currently reads '…Check the other channels in the meantime.'). Everything else in the batch verified clean.
